notes: Source entity is the listed parent's consolidated report; the investment-policy activity sits in הפניקס חברה לביטוח בע"מ, whose own standalone report was not used.
Amounts in NIS thousands as printed; nothing calculated. Section 5.2 of the directors' report presents receipts only as an image chart, so the notes to the financial statements were used.
IFRS 4 annual report; the 2024 figures differ slightly from the IFRS 17 restated 2024 figures printed in the 2025 reports (receipts 9,744,639 here vs 9,740,419; fees 210,671 vs 213,776).
